production.note: Calendar build years (never sold new in the US). L'Automobile Sportive (Sébastien Dupuis) heads its page 'FERRARI 288-GTO (1984 - 1986)'. Sources disagree on the last year: Conceptcarz 'During its production run from 1984 through 1985, 272 vehicles were produced' (conceptcarz-288gto); duPont Registry (Khris Bharath) 'Built between 1984 and 1987' (dupont-288gto). 272 were built (silodrome-288gto: 'Ferrari built 272 examples'). See reviewNotes. End year: sources disagree (Conceptcarz 1985, L'Automobile Sportive 1986, duPont Registry 1987); the owner accepted 1986 on 5 October 2026.

body.note: Two-seat mid-engined berlinetta; no open version.

configuration.note: Ferrari: 'Displacement of the V8 is actually reduced to 2.8 litres'

displacementL.note: 2,855 cc. L'Automobile Sportive: 'Cylindrée: 2855 cm3'; Silodrome: 'from 2855cc' (silodrome-288gto). Ferrari's magazine calls it 2.8 litres; the guide rounds the cc figure.

aspiration.note: Ferrari: 'twin IHI turbochargers that boost with a vicious kick'

fuel.note: Silodrome: 'Weber-Marelli electronic fuel injection'; petrol engine inferred from the description.

drivetrain.note: L'Automobile Sportive: 'Boîte de vitesses (rapports): BVM 5 rapports, propulsion'

transmission.note: Ferrari: 'the five-speed manual gearbox on view at the rear of the car'

powerHp.note: Home-market (European) rating, metric: 400 CV x 0.98632 = 394.5, rounded to 395 hp. Quote (Ferrari magazine): "The result is a brutal 400 CV punch in a feathery body weighing just 1160kg before fluids" (reproduced on a second request). L'Automobile Sportive: 'Puissance: 400 ch à 7000 tr/mn'. Never sold new in the US, so the home-market rating is used.

weightLb.note: DRY weight: 1,160 kg x 2.20462 = 2,557.4, rounded to 2,557 lb. Quote (Ferrari magazine): "a feathery body weighing just 1160kg before fluids". Silodrome (Ben Branch): 'total weight of 1160 kgs (2557.4 lbs)' (silodrome-288gto); duPont Registry: 'Around 1,160 kilograms (2,557 pounds)' on a dry basis (dupont-288gto); L'Automobile Sportive: 'Données constructeur (kg): 1160'. No kerb weight was found in a manufacturer page or a major magazine panel (Evo's 288 GTO page could not be found). Step 4 of the weight order (manufacturer dry weight).
